name: shopify-app-builder
description: Beginner-friendly Shopify app engineering skills for researching, building, testing, launching and maintaining merchant-safe apps.

interface.longDescription: A local, open-source Shopify app-building guide with 35 focused skills, 13 guided command definitions and 8 specialist-agent definitions. Beginners get small milestones, clear explanations, safe defaults and verification. Covers official Shopify CLI/Dev Dashboard setup, optional Apify CLI competitor research, app architecture, APIs, auth, billing, webhooks, extensions, merchant UX, testing, privacy and release readiness. No bundled MCP server, account binding, automatic store access or required paid research. Execution depends on the user's coding harness and separately authorized tools; native command/agent support varies.
defaultPrompt: Find guidance for Shopify app OAuth and webhook verification.
Open the Shopify app billing guidance and summarize key checks.
Plan a Shopify app that syncs inventory and handles product webhooks.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.0.1 fixes release validation for the approved verified business identity in public publisher fields and clarifies Claude directory-only metadata and static artwork. Retains 35 beginner-first skills, 13 guided command definitions and 8 specialist-agent definitions, with no bundled MCP server. Existing v1.x MCP connections must be removed separately from each host.
